svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: From device to readiness: every layer, coloured by where the data comes from
svg.text: From device to readiness: every layer, coloured by where the data comes from
Data flows up, from source pillars at the bottom to the root pillar at the top. Dashed = possible, or built but unused.

g.text: one score pillar today; Health and Nutrition could split out

svg.text: % = share of readiness. Coloured bars on a unit = its source today. Dots on a metric: filled = supplies it today, hollow = could. * = not built yet.
Health and Nutrition are possible score pillars: today their units sit inside Body. Latency also reads raw heart rate at sleep onset (direct path only).
The Oura API (#2808) would send the same ring metrics, minus beat-to-beat data, per-minute steps and daytime HRV.
